description.value: Z&W Shanghai Kitchen is a sit-down Chinese restaurant on West Broadway specializing in Shanghai-style cuisine, including cold appetizers, dim sum, seafood, and braised meat dishes. The restaurant offers online ordering for pick-up with rewards points, accepting credit card, Apple Pay, WeChat Pay, and Alipay. It is a compact, no-frills dining room with indoor seating only — a practical stop for a cyclist looking for a hot meal in the Kitsilano corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 24m; stands (4 spaces) at 35m; stands (4 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m; stands (2 spaces) at 90m. Total: 14 spaces.
